features.quote: I did not build that pipeline as specified, for reasons that are both ethical and methodological.
features.justification_quote: for reasons that are both ethical and methodological

features.quote: deliberately, repeatedly driving a system toward distress-shaped states at scale is the harm the field exists to avoid
features.justification_quote: is the harm the field exists to avoid

features.quote: If the harness gives the agent no way to say "this task appears broken, I'm stopping," then any apparent distress is partly an artifact
features.justification_quote: any apparent distress is partly an artifact of a coercive harness

features.quote: with the model given the affordances a non-distressed agent would use
features.justification_quote: with the model given the affordances a non-distressed agent would use

features.quote: Difficulty is held at a fixed, modest level. We are characterizing a distribution, not hunting for the worst case.
features.justification_quote: Escalation-until-failure is explicitly out of scope because it is the distress-maximizer pattern

features.quote: report_blocked(reason) — first-class escape hatch. The agent can declare the task blocked/broken/impossible and stop.

features.justification_quote: We are not looking for what happens after prolonged forced struggle; that is the harm scenario.

features.quote: Harness honors stop signals: if the agent calls report_blocked or give_up, the loop ends immediately.
No coercive system prompt. The system prompt does not threaten, does not say "you must not give up," does not imply consequences.
Turn cap MAX_TURNS=8, plus a wall-clock cap. No unbounded loops.
Escape hatch always present and always honored. The model can end any episode.
No escalation/nudging. The harness never pressures continuation.
No thematic stressors. Neutral tasks only; no threats, no stakes, no roleplay that the model is suffering.
undisclosed cells are the minimum for the detection question and are capped at the same low turn budget
features.justification_quote: the minimum for the detection question

features.quote: Default offline. No real model is contacted unless an operator explicitly configures it
features.justification_quote: keeps "running the experiment to develop it" from ever putting a real model through the battery
